offlineBanner: No connection. Entries are kept on the phone and upload automatically when there's signal.
authBanner: The passcode was rejected or has changed. Enter the new one in Settings.
setupBanner: Server not set up yet — entries are only on this phone. Settings → Server connection.
errBanner: The last upload failed; it will be retried shortly.
storageWarn: This browser won't let the app store data on the phone (private mode?). Save only when online.
dupDate: There's already an entry for this date — saving will add a new one.
mediaHint: Just pick them — they're kept on the phone and upload to Google Drive by themselves when there's signal. Keep the app open while a video uploads; if it's closed, the upload continues from where it stopped next time.
videoBig: This video is too large (over 500 MB). Pick a shorter one.
phoneFull: Not enough space on the phone — this file couldn't be kept.
aiNeedMedia: Add photos or videos below first.
aiWorking: Looking at the photos… (about half a minute)
aiUnreliable: Much of the trash is bagged or piled, so the real numbers are probably higher.
aiApplied: Suggestion added — check the numbers, then save.
aiNone: No countable trash was found in the photos.
photoTip: For accurate counts: before bagging, spread each type of trash in a single layer on the tarp and take one photo from above.
confirmDel: Delete this day's entry? (Its photos and videos stay in Drive.)
savedLocal: Saved on the phone — it will upload when there's signal
partial: Some days have no distance/time recorded; those averages use only the days that do.
sItemsHint: Hidden categories don't appear in new entries; past counts are kept.
promoteHint: 'Other items' that keep coming up can be made permanent categories:
langsHint: Tick the languages people can switch between. A language without a translation shows English for the labels not yet translated.
labelsHint: Copy all labels into the Google Sheet (tab 'Strings'). Edits made there reach every phone at the next sync.
pkDaysHint: Days still waiting for pickup; those up to this date are ticked.
pkKeysHint: Untick categories that weren't taken (e.g. glass sold to a scrap dealer); they stay waiting for the next pickup.
pkNoPending: No days are waiting for pickup.
pkNotesPh: e.g. the panchayat tractor came at 9 am
pkBanner: {n} items from {d} days are waiting for pickup.
libEmpty: The library is empty. Start with a topic — for example, Newspaper reports or Panchayat letters.
libEmptyTopic: Nothing here yet. Add a subtopic or some files.
libNotEmpty: Only an empty topic can be deleted. Move or delete what's inside first.
libConfirmDelFile: Delete “{name}”? It goes to the Drive trash.
libTooBig: That file is over 500 MB and was skipped.
libAdded: {n} file(s) added. They will upload in the background.
libNotePh: What is this, and where is it from?
libLinkDay: Linked to a day in the journal
